name: JW Marriott Hotel Seoul
positioning: Luxury hotel in Seoul's Gangnam District, directly linked to three Seoul Metro lines, with Korean-modern rooms, river-view penthouses, an extensive indoor pool area and the Marquis Fitness Club
best_for: Travelers who want a Gangnam base with direct metro and express bus connections
Guests who put fitness, swimming and spa time at the center of a city stay

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of South Korea's Gangnam District.
The hotel is directly linked to three lines of Seoul Metro.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel sits above shopping and the express bus terminal and subway.
Rooms have expansive bedrooms and bathrooms with window-side relaxing sofas.
Rooms have an in-room Nespresso machine.
The Presidential Penthouse and Ambassador Penthouse sit at the highest levels of the hotel as multi-level suites with city and river views.
Conde Nast Traveler notes high floors provide river views.
The Spa's signature Wholeness Package begins with a detox session followed by scalp, facial and body treatments.
The Executive Lounge on the 9th floor takes up the whole floor.
Tamayura is a Japanese restaurant offering kaiseki, Edomae sushi omakase and a teppanyaki counter.
The Margaux Grill cooks seafood and premium beef on a bespoke wood fire.

highlights.text: The pool area has a six-lane indoor pool, a therapy pool, a children's pool, a scuba diving pool, a whirlpool and cabanas.
The Presidential Penthouse is a two-bedroom duplex with floor-to-ceiling windows looking over Seoul, the Han River and Mt. Namsan.
Marquis Fitness Club facilities include a jogging track, Pilates room, screen golf zone, squash court and basketball court.
Guest rooms combine traditional Korean and modern interior notes.
JW Garden on the 7th floor is a green space for sunsets and fresh breezes.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel is a few metro stops from attractions and the city center.
The Spa closes every third Thursday of the month.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may not suit those seeking a tranquil retreat.
